objective:
Follow these steps literally, one at a time, from the current page. Click only what each step names. Never type a URL, search, or take another route.
Where to find them, in the tutorial's own words: "Next browse to any Wikipedia page and click the “Add this page to your book” link to include that article into your ebook."
1. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Add this page to your book'.
If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.
